span.p:
No competing master
R1 / R2 / R3 differ by 3 cycles
320,898 to 320,901

div.style: color: rgb(43, 36, 24) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Same-region contention
R1: +16,979 cycles
R2: +16,944 cycles

span.p:
R1 and R2 cross-region
+29 to +59 cycles
near baseline

span.p:
R3 asymmetry
R3 traffic to R1 / R2: about +4.7%
reverse direction: near baseline
